title: Quietly Pungent Peruvian Dulce De Leche Suspiro Limeno
description: A silky and kid-friendly Peruvian dessert featuring dulce de leche, made with water, lardons-render, and anti-inflammatory-friendly ingredients, served in a claypot.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, combine the evaporated milk, granulated sugar, and salt, and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened slightly.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the rendered lardons, vanilla extract, and cinnamon.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and water until well combined.
Gradually add the warm milk mixture to the egg yolks, whisking constantly to prevent the eggs from scrambling.
Pour the mixture into 6 small claypots or ramekins and place them in a large baking dish.
Add hot water to the baking dish to come halfway up the sides of the claypots.

Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the claypots from the water bath and let them cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled.
